services.desc: Top-rated pontoon and bowrider rentals on Estero Bay and the Gulf Coast. Launching daily from the Imperial River Ramp. From $415/day. Bonita Springs is one of the best launching points on Florida's Gulf Coast. Situated at the southern end of Lee County, it gives boaters direct access to Estero Bay - a vast, protected estuary stretching from Wiggins Pass south toward Marco Island - and quick runs to the open Gulf of Mexico. Borrow-A-Boat Rentals is Bonita Springs' top-rated boat rental company with a 5.0-star rating on Google. services.desc: Two spacious pontoons, up to 12 guests. Explore Estero Bay, Fort Myers Beach sandbars, and the open Gulf Coast. No captain needed. Pontoon boats are the most versatile choice for Southwest Florida waters. Their wide, stable deck makes them perfect for families with kids, large groups celebrating birthdays or anniversaries, and anyone who wants to relax in the sun while cruising the Gulf Coast. From the Imperial River Ramp in Bonita Springs, you're minutes from the sandbars of Estero Bay, the open Gulf of Mexico, and the beaches of Fort Myers.
